summary: Mesthles (Ancient Greek: Μέσθλης) is a Trojan ally, son of Talaemenes and a Gygaean nymph, who with his brother Antiphus captains the Maeonians (Lydians) from the region of Mount Tmolus / Sardis in the Iliad.

sections.heading: Maeonian captain
paragraphs: Homer's Catalogue of Ships (Iliad 2.864–866) and Apollodorus (Epitome 3.35) make Mesthles and Antiphus sons of Talaemenes, born of the Gygaean lake-nymph, leaders of the Maeonian contingent. Hector later rouses Mesthles among the allied captains fighting over Patroclus' body.
The Maeonians are the Lydian people whose later capital is Sardis; Mesthles has no independent episode beyond the muster and battlefield command.
